content:
User test (playtest done with an AI agent for TidyMaze):
Tested: 6 demo games with my own C++ bots.
Bugs:
- The default AI opponent times out at turn 2 in all 6 games and never moves (replay: https://www.codingame.com/replay/921656159).
- Thrust above 5 is accepted: "MOVE 1000 540 10" gives vx 7, 13, 19, 24 on turns 2 to 5 (replay: https://www.codingame.com/replay/921656012). The statement example uses 10.
- A zero direction vector is not defined: "MOVE 0 0 5" still accelerates the player to the right (replay: https://www.codingame.com/replay/921655875, turn 2).
Unclear rules:
- confirmed: the input is 3 lines per turn (player, opponent, ball), not 21.
- MOVE dirx diry is a direction vector, not a target: "MOVE 0 540 5" from (430, 540) makes vy grow 4, 8, 11, 14.
- The Game Input section says "your player" for line 1 and for line 9, which is the opponent's x.
- nbut 1 is the goal on the right (x 1920): shots towards (1920, 540) gave our score 8 and the opponent 0 in both v2 games (replays: https://www.codingame.com/replay/921656159 and https://www.codingame.com/replay/921656225). nbut 2 was not tested.
- "Get more cross than the BOSS" gives no turn limit, tie rule, goal size or goal scoring rule.
Suggestions:
- Describe the 3-line input and that MOVE dirx diry is a direction vector.
- Give one thrust range, the zero-vector behaviour, and a working default AI.
Good: short input, clear map size and time limits.
